in_hebrew.name: Gert
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gert הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old German word 'geriz,' meaning 'spear.' The name 'Gert' was derived from this word and was used to denote a spear bearer or warrior. In the Middle Ages, it was also used as a pet form of Gerhard or Gerhardus, which means 'brave with a spear.'
